Priyansh Arya Hits Record 181 in SMAT T20 Match

Priyansh Arya scored 181 runs in a SMAT T20 fixture, hitting 19 sixes. His innings surpassed KL Rahul's record for the highest T20 score by an Indian. Arya's performance included taking 22 runs off consecutive overs from bowlers R. Silambarasan and Sai Kishore during the PowerPlay.
